$comment: README auto-update workflow SSOT (Issue #180). Consumed by .github/workflows/readme-autoupdate.yml and scripts/ci/readme-sync.sh. This file is always loaded from the origin/main ref (trusted) by the workflow - never from the PR head - because it defines the security enforcement boundary (managedFiles, push target, commit identity) and the pinned model/version. The model is intentionally fixed to opencode/big-pickle and cannot be overridden by repository variables or PR-controlled configuration; verify-config fails closed on any other value.
